name: normalize-email
prompt: Implement `normalize_email(raw: str) -> str` in emailnorm.py. It returns one email address in canonical form: surrounding whitespace removed and every character lowercased. If the trimmed input contains no '@' (this includes empty or whitespace-only input), raise ValueError. Use only the Python standard library. The tests in test_emailnorm.py assert this contract — make them pass without modifying the test file.
context: A single-module Python project with no dependencies. Run `python3 -m unittest` to check your work.
